newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan buys spot fuel oil at $33.90/T premium.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys spot fuel oil at $33.90/T premium.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources bought by a spot tender 50,000 tonnes of fuel oil at a premium of $33.90 a tonne to MidEast spot quotes, cost-and-freight Keamari, a ministry official said on Tuesday.
The 1.0-percent sulphur, 125-centistoke grade fuel oil was purchased from MidEast trader Bakri Trading, who made the only offer to the tender.
The cargo was for end-March delivery.
The tender was issued on February 5 to meet the emergency requirement of a power station. It closed on February 17.
It its last spot tender for November delivery, Pakistan bought fuel oil at a premium of $22.99 a tonne to MidEast spot quotes, c-and-f Keamari.
